name: PR.com

sources.title: PR.com homepage — business directory + press-release distribution; 'Join Now' → admin.pr.com/create-account
Press Release Distribution Pricing — $60/$100/$300 tiers; a Free package with reduced distribution exists; '$29.95 per link' noted

conditions: Free account + free business-profile posting in the business directory ('Post Your Profile', 'Create Free Account')

Press-release distribution has a Free package but with 'reduced distribution to general search engines, in PR.com, some 3rd party and news websites, and RSS feeds' — real reach starts at $60 and the pricing page shows a '$29.95 per link' note
requirements: Account creation at admin.pr.com/create-account (the batch-provided pr.com/pr-signup.php URL returned 404 — real signup lives on the admin subdomain)
Two distinct products: (1) free business directory profile with products & services listings; (2) paid press-release distribution
Company profile supports full descriptions, images, specifications, editable any time
preparation: Company name, description, industry category, logo/images
Products/services descriptions for the products-services directory
If using press release: a written release (headline, body, contact info, image)
workflow: Create a free account at https://admin.pr.com/create-account
Post the business profile (Post Your Profile → /business-profiles) — this is the free directory listing
Add products & services entries under the profile
Optionally submit a press release via admin.pr.com/info_press_item.php — choose the free package or a paid tier ($60/$100/$300)
Verify the profile appears in the business directory
watchFor: Batch's pr-signup.php URL is dead — signup is on admin.pr.com
The free press-release tier is heavily reduced-distribution; the paid-tier upsell is the core business model
'$29.95 per link' note on the pricing page suggests per-link charges in releases — check before submitting a link-heavy release
Directory and press release are separate flows; a business profile does not publish a press release
countsAsLive: The company profile is publicly visible in the PR.com business directory at a pr.com/... URL, or the press release appears under /press-release/<id>
unknowns: Whether free business-profile website links are dofollow
Approval turnaround for new profiles and free-tier press releases
What the '$29.95 per link' fee applies to exactly
